response.justification: Bogdan has over 12 years of full-stack experience with deep proficiency in TypeScript, Node.js, React, and cloud tools like AWS CDK, aligning strongly with the required stack. His hands-on work with AI-agent infrastructure, testing frameworks (including Vitest-like ecosystems), and containerization demonstrates relevant expertise. His open-source contributions and teaching background reflect strong communication and engineering discipline, though his German language skills are basic, which may slightly limit local collaboration.
strengths: Extensive full-stack experience with TypeScript, Node.js, React, and cloud platforms
Proven track record in AI-agent development and testing infrastructure (Vitest-aligned)
Strong open-source contributions and technical communication through workshops and talks
concerns: German language proficiency is only basic, potentially limiting team integration in Berlin
Limited explicit mention of Nest.js or Vitest in resume, though equivalent tools are used
Some roles involve legacy or niche stacks (e.g., DLang), which may raise questions about focus
